title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1246: Zhu tiandao’s madness (3)

section.p: At the same time.

While gasping for breath, First Yellow said, “Kid, we’ll be there soon. Think carefully. Are you really staying here? You’ll die. If you want, I can take you further away before we go our different ways…”

Su Yu said nothing. Grandstar’s voice could be heard in his ears, “The entrance is in the area. Go straight up with that little furball raised above you. That entrance is very hard to open through regular means, but you can open it easily with that furball.”
Su Yu was starting to feel doubtful.
Raising the furball?
What?
Fine. He did not need to understand. It was unlikely that Grandstar would mess with him, right?
If Grandstar wanted him dead, there were plenty of easier ways to do so. Su Yu raised the little furball and started flying straight up with Yellow Nine in tow.
First Yellow complained, “We’re already here! Why are you not releasing her?”

At that moment, he felt himself running into a sort of barrier. But with the barrier above him, he was able to force his way through. And then, a faintly discernible portal appeared. First Yellow blanked out. What? There was a realm entrance here? Was this a joke? As a former member of the Yellow Department, he was certain the pavilion was unaware of this entrance. Furthermore, this was a surprisingly stable entrance.
As an expert spatial manipulator, he should have been able to sense this portal right after arriving. But he hadn’t been able to sense anything.
Nevertheless, he finally understood why Su Yu wanted to come here. There was a portal here he could use to flee. Further behind them, Lade and the others were greatly surprised as well.
A portal?
Here?
How was that possible?

When they saw Su Yu moving toward the portal, the grew anxious. The portal might end up delivering each of them to a different location. In that situation, it would be much harder for them to locate Su Yu again. Someone else might benefit from the treasures in Su Yu’s hands instead.
Just as First Yellow was about to say something, Su Yu tossed Yellow Nine to him and said, “Don’t follow me. You can try if you feel brave enough, but I wouldn’t recommend that.”

After catching Yellow Nine, First Yellow considered running through the portal anyway. But soon, he gave up. Su Yu was too dangerous an individual. He should flee elsewhere instead. All these Invincibles were here for Su Yu. It was much safer for him to not be anywhere near Su Yu.

Having made his decision, First Yellow started fleeing in a different direction with Yellow Nine. The furious Yellow Nine did not forget to make her displeasure known, “Su Yu, I won’t let this slide! I will remember what you did to my arm!”
“Dumbass.”

Su Yu snorted. As far as he was concerned, Yellow Nine should count herself lucky. If it wasn’t for First Yellow’s previous claim, he would have killed her by now. Even getting First Yellow killed was not out of the question.

But eventually, he gave up on that idea. On the slightest chance that Yellow Nine was really from the Liu Family, he wouldn’t be able to explain himself to Teacher Liu after killing her. As for her identity as a human, that was not a concern for him. So what if she was a human? It wasn’t like he had never killed any human before.

Su Yu dove into the portal heading to the Allheaven Battlefield. Let’s see if these Invincibles would have the courage to come after him. He wondered if the stone statue would be reliable. As Invincibles, their senses were still very sensitive toward danger. If they decided to not follow him through the portal, humanity would be in trouble.

He also wondered if the stone statue was in the Human Realm or the Allheaven Battlefield. Also, could the stone statue handle this? There were three Invincibles to handle. Sure, he had seen the stone statue destroying some tri-life bodies before. But he had never seen the stone statue truly killing any Invincibles. He couldn’t help but worry. Ultimately, he stopped worrying. It wasn’t like he had a different alternative.
At the other side of the portal.
The stone statue had arrived in advance. He looked around and noted that nobody was in the area.

The many Invincibles were busy fighting elsewhere. The stone statue nodded with satisfaction. He still had to keep a low profile. Thus, he aimed to finish these Invincibles without leaving any witnesses.

Survival in the Allheaven Battlefield was a concern even for these ancient cities. If the myriad races were to learn of his involvement here, some trouble might befall the ancient cities. He would like to avoid that if possible.
“Zhu Tiandao…”
As the stone statue muttered that name, he reached a decision.

Zhu Tiandao was still following behind them, right? Zhu Tiandao shall serve as the fall guy for the deaths of the three Invincibles. Grandstar reminded himself to finish each Invincible with one punch. As long as he could do that, nobody would be aware of his involvement.
With that, Grandstar started waiting with anticipation. As he waited, a layer of stone slowly faded from his skin.
A cold, modest, ancient, and handsome appearance was revealed.

His eyes were akin to radiant stars while his eyebrows were as sharp as swords. No longer was he the silly-looking stone statue. He now had the appearance befitting his status as a super expert. Even Su Yu would agree to this if he were to see Grandstar’s current appearance.
Before long, Su Yu appeared with the furball. He looked around and saw nothing.
He was just about to panic when a voice rang out in his ears, “Move aside. You’re in the way.”
Su Yu was overjoyed. He hurriedly moved out of the way.
In the Human Realm, the three Invincibles noted that the portal was still open.
Devil King Mohe asked, “Do we go?”

“Yes!” Divine King Huoji said, “This is a new portal. The humans might not be aware of this portal as well. We’ll kill Su Yu before killing Kong Qingzi and his charge. With them dead, we will be the only ones aware of this portal…”

Sure, Zhu Tiandao and the others were behind them, but Divine King Huoji was also confident they could kill Zhu Tiandao’s group as well. Since this was an unknown portal, the three were quite curious about where it was connected to.

Thus, two of them rushed into the portal without much hesitation. Behind them, Devil King Lade clenched his teeth and rushed forth as well. Su Yu was his! He wouldn’t allow anyone to take those treasures from him!
“The carrier treasures are mine. You can have the Culture Tomb!”

Devil King Lade was clearly losing his calm. The other two Invincibles completely ignored him. They could talk about that after killing Su Yu. What was the point of splitting the loot before getting the loot?
The first to appear on the other side was Devil King Mohe.
He was slightly faster than the other two.
He was greeted by a stone statue…no, at the moment, Grandstar was no longer a stone statue.
A punch was thrown.

Devil King Mohe’s expression changed drastically. But before he could react, his head burst apart, followed by his body. A River of Time appeared as yet another Devil King Mohe walked out of the river only to be greeted by another punch.

The second punch was even faster and stronger than the previous punch. The shockwaves of the attack struck Divine King Huoji right as he stepped out of the portal. As he coughed blood, his face paled with panic. He wanted to pull back, but Devil King Lade was behind him, blocking his way.
A rain of punches descended upon them.
Devil King Mohe lost his second body.
Behind the two Invincibles, Devil King Lade panicked.
What was going on?
Wait, those punches…looked familiar. As a certain memory struck him, his expression turned into one of extreme horror.
Grandstar!
It was him!
He wanted to shout, but he couldn’t even do so. After the collision between him and the panicking Divine King Huoji, he fell to the ground while coughing blood.
Finally, Zhu Tiandao and company arrived.
They were quite surprised to see a portal there.
Right after their arrival, a voice rang out in their ears, “Start throwing attacks above you. Now. Hold nothing back. Ignite your blood essence.”
Zhu Tiandao was stunned. What? Wan Tiansheng’s eyes flickered as he noted who it was. Grandstar! He had heard Grandstar’s voice once.
He did not hesitate and ignited his blood essence as he roared to his companions, “Do it! Now!”
Zhu Tiandao and Lan Tian were still confused, but they did not hesitate and followed Wan Tiansheng’s lead. Just like Wan Tiansheng, Zhu Tiandao ignited his blood essence and threw a punch.
As for Lan Tian, he turned into countless Lan Tians before throwing countless punches out.

A powerful undulation rippled across the sky, gathered their attacks, and turned into a beam of light. Lade and Huoji, who were retreating toward the portal, panicked as they saw the incoming attack. With a roar, both of them attacked.
The clash pushed them further away from the portal. Both paled when they realized that.
“No…”
Even when Wan Tiansheng, Zhu Tiandao, and Lan Tian worked together, they wouldn’t be able to kill the two Invincibles. But they were able to push the two Invincibles up into the sky.

And waiting up in the sky was an extremely terrifying existence. The two Invincibles despaired as they realized they were being sent right toward that existence. Right at that moment, a rain of punches dropped from the sky.
The final surviving body of Mohe looked at the incoming punches with despair. He manifested his River of Time yet again, but the river instantly snapped. He had been in battle for quite a long time.
He was far from his peak condition. After arriving here, he had even lost two of his bodies to a sneak attack. And now, he was attacked from two directions. Apart from despair, he felt nothing else.
It was in such despair that his body was blasted apart.
Crimson clouds spread across the Allheaven Battlefield.
The entire Devil Realm shook.
This was the first devil king to die today. Prior to this, the nether, immortal, divine, and human races had each lost an Invincible. And now, the devil race had joined the club.
All around the Myriad Realms, numerous experts looked in the direction of the human-immortal border.
The devil king seemed to have perished there.
A devil king…
Was it Devil King Mohe? Instead of Devil King Lade, Devil King Mohe was the one to die? How surprising.
Meanwhile, Devil King Lade was shouting with desperation, “You shouldn’t have left your city! You can’t act against us! We’re nowhere near any of your cities!”
Finally, Devil King Lade’s final body was killed as well. He died with boundless indignance.
He was unwilling to accept this.
Even more crimson clouds appeared while the Devil Realm shook yet again. Outside the Devil Realm, the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s projection reappeared.
Fury and confusion could be seen in his eyes.
How?
He looked at the location where two of his devil kings had perished. The Immortal Realm was not very far away from that place. What was Tiangu doing? Why was he ignoring something this big?
Outside the Immortal Realm.
The two furballs burped as they looked in the direction of their home. The female furball said, “Husband, they’re fighting in front of our home.”
The big furball said nothing. He looked at the entrance of the Immortal Realm and said, “Tiangu will probably come out soon. He’s losing his calm. We’ll eat him when he’s out.”
“Yay!”
The female furball agreed cheerily.
Eat! Eat Tiangu!
Since something so big had happened near the Immortal Realm, Tiangu would probably come out soon. After losing several strands of willpower in a row to them, Tiangu was probably going mad in there.
Meanwhile, Grandstar was still unaware of what was happening near the Immortal Realm.
After killing two Invincibles in a row, heavenly rewards were dropping from the sky.

There were so many rewards Su Yu didn’t even know which among them he should look at anymore. Heavenearth profound light, willpower, characters, weapons, cultivation methods…it was as though anything a cultivator could ask for was dropping from the sky.
Were killing Invincibles so rewarding?
Grandstar appeared indifferent. These rewards weren’t too useful for him. He was more concerned about finishing the battle and leaving as soon as possible.
One punch, two punches, three punches…
He continued raining punches from the sky.
Near the portal, Divine King Huoji faced the attacks while roaring repeatedly.

First, his combined body burst apart. Then, his future body burst apart. Not far away, Su Yu stole a glance at the stone statue before throwing his punches as well. He couldn’t see the Invincible too well, but he knew that he only needed to throw his punches in the general direction of the portal.

With the stone statue above him and the three human experts below him, the divine king was trapped without a way to escape. By the time the stone statue had thrown tens of thousands of punches, Su Yu had thrown hundreds of punches. He was trying to get some hits in hope of getting some heavenly rewards as well.
Wan Tiansheng and the others were incredibly shocked at what was happening, but they couldn’t afford to stop as they continued attacking as well.

Meanwhile, Divine King Huoji was still roaring in despair as he defended himself. Finally, his River of Time snapped while his final surviving body burst apart. The Divine Realm shook and more crimson clouds spread across the Myriad Realms.
At almost the same moment, Grandstar roared loudly, “I, Zhu Tiandao, am unstoppable!”
That shout could be heard throughout the Myriad Realms.
Then, he kicked Su Yu back into the portal while sending a voice transmission, “I’ll seal the portal. Go to the Allheaven Prefecture and leave through the portal there. Don’t tell anyone I was here.”
It was time for him to run. More people would arrive before long.
Grandstar was feeling both nervous and excited. Even someone like him had not killed that many Invincibles before. And today, three Invincibles had actually lined up to die in his hands.
He had to ensure nobody knew about this or he would be in trouble. After sealing the portal, he vanished.
As for the dead Invincibles, Zhu Tiandao was naturally the killer.
“I, Zhu Tiandao, am unstoppable!”
That declaration spread everywhere.
Due to the sheer shock everyone was feeling, even the intense battles were paused.
Three.
Three Invincibles had died instantly.
That was alarming.
Mohe, Huoji, and Lade had died in succession.
Zhu Tiandao…
“Zhu Tiandao!”

Someone recalled who that name belonged to. Zhu Tiandao, second son of Great Ming King. Was this real? Did he really kill four Invincibles in the span of one day? Was this a joke? Even a Pseudo Emperor would need to get lucky to achieve such a feat.
“Zhu Tiandao…is this even possible?”
Everyone was stunned.
That was too terrifying.
Human Realm.
When Zhu Tiandao heard that declaration, he looked at his two companions and said blankly, “This was how that immortal king died earlier as well…”
Wasn’t he amazing? He had killed four Invincibles in a day.
Holy shit!

He could forget about leaving his home from now on. Zhu Tiandao was losing his mind. He had become a super expert out of nowhere. This was terrifying. Someone so impressive was probably worthy of being the assassination target of even Pseudo Emperors, right?
